content.text: The visible suite now passes (1 passed). I changed one file, `solution/core.py`. The cause was the `_expired` helper, which compared age with `>` against the TTL, so an entry was still live at exactly `ttl` seconds old. I changed the comparison to `>=`, so an entry expires once its age reaches the TTL. `get`, `put` and `_purge` all go through `_expired`, so this one change covers every path. I did not touch anything under `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `TTLCache` public API. I did not run the hidden suite, so boundary cases beyond the exact-TTL one are unverified.
